title: Project
description: <project>/.claude/project.yaml (and project.local.yaml): what a project declares it needs.

context.description: Short project description injected into every role.

read_first.description: Files every agent reads before starting.

modules.description: Extra module directories, relative to the project root.

runs.description: Directory for flow run state, relative to the project root. Default: .ai-runs (outside .claude/, which Claude Code guards with permission prompts).

cli.description: Command generated skills use to run this CLI. Default: node "<absolute path to stack.mjs>".

settings.description: Where the build manages permissions and policy hooks: .claude/settings.local.json (local, default), .claude/settings.json (shared), or nowhere (none). Only entries the build added are ever changed or removed.

scope.description: Paths agents may edit, relative to the project root. Shorthand for enabling the policy 'scope' with these paths.

permissions.description: Extra permissions.allow entries the build manages, e.g. the project's check commands. Packs set them through defaults.

knowledge.description: Directory of durable project knowledge, relative to the project root, with an INDEX.md. Agents consult it; the scribe writes to it.

flows.description: Flow overrides; `steps` may be a map keyed by step id to change single steps, e.g. { plan: { gate: auto } }.
